findings.title: Migration naming docs contradict each other and the repo's actual 5302xxx sequence
findings.note: REGRESSED at 6b7aa1a: docs/migrations/naming-guide.md:5-40 and docs/SUPABASE_MIGRATION_WORKFLOW.md:30-31 mandate a unique sequential 5302NNN prefix ('Duplicate prefixes are not allowed'), but the tree now has two migrations with prefix 5302463 (5302463_client_portal_ai_and_visibility.sql and 5302463_fix_notification_key_dedup_index.sql), and the first one's header comment says '5302437' (line 2), the wrong number. The workflow doc also still names 5302458 as the newest example while the newest file is 5302463. Ordering between the two same-prefix files is lexicographic by filename rather than the documented sequence. Fix: renumber the later file to 5302464+, correct the header comment, update the example, and add a duplicate-prefix guard to the migration checks.

findings.title: AGENTS.md Known Debt contradicts the ops docs on the prod-approval reviewer gate and on main/develop divergence
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a: AGENTS.md:124 says prod-approval 'now has a required reviewer (verified 2026-10-15), so the manual-approval gate is in force', but docs/FINAL_DEPLOYMENT_OPERATIONS_HANDBOOK.md:108, docs/ROLLBACK_PROCEDURES.md:350-353 and docs/RELEASING.md:190-195 all say required reviewers are still not configured / there is no working gate. The same AGENTS bullet says 'main now carries 26 commits that develop does not', while the audited tree is `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...origin/develop` = 1 0. The heading is still dated 'Known Debt (2026-08-29)' although the content was refreshed 2026-10-15 (PR #293). The repo cannot verify GitHub environment settings, so at least one of these current-state claims is wrong. Fix: pick one verified source, date it, and make AGENTS/FINAL/ROLLBACK/RELEASING agree; re-check the branch-divergence sentence at each promotion.

findings.title: docs/RELEASING.md still records PR #281 @ 7dd04023 as the last promotion; main is now 6b7aa1a (2026-11-03)

The before-promotion checklist still tells operators to compare against a stale baseline. Fix: update the branch-state paragraph as part of the release/promotion checklist (or derive it from `git describe`/the latest tag).

findings.title: docs/API_ERROR_HANDLING.md names the 429 code as FULL, while the rate-limit middleware and docs/API_RATE_LIMITING.md return RATE_LIMITED
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a: the recent JSON-429 change makes every limiter return failure('RATE_LIMITED', ..., 429) (apps/api/src/middleware/rate-limit.ts:13-16), and docs/API_RATE_LIMITING.md:60-67 documents code RATE_LIMITED. docs/API_ERROR_HANDLING.md:81 still says '429 | FULL (and rate-limit middleware)', so client code following the error-handling table branches on a code that rate-limited requests never carry. Fix: replace FULL with RATE_LIMITED (and note FULL is the capacity code) in the table.
